verdict.rationale: Phoenix has an LLM-invoking Prompt Playground, so consuming tools from external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack only documents the opposite role: Phoenix exposes its own `/mcp` endpoint for external MCP clients such as Claude Code and Cursor, which does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing in the evidence shows Phoenix connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools.
